course.name: EliteClouds Trading Education
course.tagline: A live futures day-trading room and a 6-week mentorship course led by Dr. Gunbharpur Gill, with guidance available in Punjabi.
course.about: EliteClouds Trading Education is a live futures trading room and mentorship program founded by Dr. Gunbharpur Gill, who has 8+ years of trading experience and provides guidance in Punjabi. The live room runs daily screen-share sessions covering NQ and ES futures, and a separate 6-week mentorship course (nine live Zoom sessions, six students per batch) covers everything from account setup through trading psychology.

formats.label: Daily live trading room
formats.description: Daily screen-share sessions at 9:15 AM ET on Discord, covering NQ and ES futures with entry/stop/target guidance.

formats.label: 6-week mentorship course
formats.description: Nine live Zoom sessions (two hours each), six students per batch.

formats.label: Guidance in Punjabi
formats.description: Live sessions and mentorship offered in Punjabi.

pricing.name: Live Room — 6 Months

_notes.source: Founder, pricing, curriculum, refund policy and testimonials confirmed directly on the official site (elitecloudstrading.ca), which also has its own Terms of Service and Risk Disclosure pages — a more established setup than most Whop-only providers we've added. The separate 6-Week Mentorship Course has no published price (shared directly with applicants), so it isn't listed as its own pricing tier here, only described. 10% affiliate commission confirmed via whoptrends.com. No Trustpilot profile found. No clean square logo found (the only images were a presenter photo and its matching favicon), so a lettermark shows instead.
